name: ui-ux-gtm
description: Design GTM UI/UX patterns — landing pages (hero, proof, CTA), forms (progressive disclosure, inline validation), signup flows (activation, time-to-value), dashboards (KPI hierarchy, trend indicators), and accessibility (WCAG 2.2 AA). Use when designing or auditing GTM tool interfaces, landing pages, conversion flows, or onboarding experiences. Covers conversion-first design, mobile optimization, and A/B test readiness.
